newsitem.title: USA: Peoples First sets 5 pct stock payout.
newsitem.headline: Peoples First sets 5 pct stock payout.

text.p: Peoples First Corp on Tuesday said its directors declared a five percent stock dividend and an unchanged quarterly cash dividend of $0.20.
The company said the cash dividend is payable on February 14 to holders of record on January 31. The stock dividend is payable on March 20 to holders of record on February 21.

It said its current indicated annual cash dividend rate was about 46 percent of financial analysts' 1996 net income per share estimate. "This payout ratio is consistent with other publicly traded banks," it said.
In 1996, Peoples First began purchasing its common shares in the open market to be used in conjunction with the stock dividend program, it said.
